interpretation: Both complete runs and all missing/late replies are retained. First repeat is mixed/failed-gate evidence; the second is failed qualification.
Latency means/p95 remain per-run original values. No pooled percentile is invented and no best-run result is selected.
Provider variability is observed but causal attribution is not established; all missing second-run phrase traces have committed ASR and foreground requests without first text before recording close.
Neither canonical repeat exercised provisional listening-cue audio; retain separate fixture/real HTTP evidence for that path.
No content judge or UTMOS; no acoustic, Pi-hardware, physical ownership or busy-worker benchmark qualification.
